TraitHint.blast: Damages every creature in the Zone (value in parentheses).
TraitHint.cleave: Each 6 deals 1 Damage to all enemies within Close Range.
TraitHint.close: No Accuracy penalty at Close Range.
TraitHint.crushing: Heavy bludgeon; used by Crushing Blow.
TraitHint.ineffective: Target Armour doubled; only Minor Injuries.
TraitHint.reach: Attack any target in your Zone.
TraitHint.rend: Each 6 destroys 1 point of Armour after the attack.
TraitHint.restraining: Damage restrains Large or smaller targets.
TraitHint.slashing: Bladed; used by Talents such as Sever.
TraitHint.spread: Creatures within Close Range of the target take half Damage.
TraitHint.stunning: Any 6 on the attack Stuns the target.

Presence.frighteningEffect: Spirit (Resolve) DN 4:X (X = number of these creatures in the Zone) or become Frightened for 1d6 rounds.
Presence.terrifyingEffect: You become Frightened for 1d6 rounds; fail Spirit (Resolve) DN 4:X and become Terrified instead.
Presence.devastatingEffect: You become Terrified for 1d6 rounds; fail Spirit (Resolve) DN 4:X and take Psychological Damage equal to your Mind.

ConditionHint.blinded: Cannot see. Sight-based Awareness DN +2; Melee, Accuracy and Defence −1 step.
ConditionHint.charmed: Cannot attack the charmer; charmer has Advantage socially.
ConditionHint.frightened: −1 die on all Tests while the source is in sight. +1 Adrenaline when gained.
ConditionHint.terrified: −2 dice on all Tests while the source is in sight. +1 Adrenaline each turn. Leaves a Minor Psychological Injury.
ConditionHint.incapacitated: No Move, Actions or Adrenaline. Attacks against you are DN 2.
ConditionHint.prone: Crawl only. Melee and Accuracy −1 step.
ConditionHint.restrained: Cannot move. Melee, Accuracy and Defence −1 step.
ConditionHint.stunned: Action or Move, not both; no extra Actions; Slow; Defence −1 step.
ConditionHint.unconscious: Drops held items, Prone and Incapacitated.
ConditionHint.critical: Death Test at the start of each turn.
ConditionHint.hidden: Attacks treat the target's Defence as Poor.
ConditionHint.dodging: Defence +1 step until your next turn.
ConditionHint.charging: Defence −1 step until your next turn.
ConditionHint.lastStand: Immune to Damage, Melee/Accuracy +1 step, armour-piercing. You die at the end of the turn.

Test.Title: Test
Test.DNTooltip: Difficulty : Complexity — each die ≥ Difficulty is a success; you need Complexity successes.
Test.AutoSuccessHint: Pool exceeds DN × Complexity — the GM may grant success without rolling.
Test.FocusTooltip: Click a die to add +1 Focus, right-click to remove.
Test.SelectReroll: Select dice to reroll with Luck
Test.InlineHint: Click: roll for your selected token / character. GM Shift-click: ask the players to roll.
Test.DegreesHint: Extra successes above the Complexity (OH p.91): 0 Pass, +1-2 Minor Benefit, +3 or more Major Benefit. The GM decides the benefit.

Attack.Title: Attack
Attack.TargetHint: Target tokens (T) to calculate DN automatically.
Attack.Head: Head (+2, Stunned)

Cast.Title: Cast Spell
Cast.NoMethods: None — requires Computational Sorcerer or Traditional Magician
Cast.EmpoweredHint: Adds dice equal to your Occult Training.
Cast.FastCastHint: Extended Test: Complexity ×3, one Action per roll, 1s > 6s mishaps, a round with no successes fails.
Cast.MentalWarning: Mental magic: Complexity +2 and always triggers a mishap.
Cast.OverheatWarning: Device overheated — every cast triggers a complication.
Cast.TargetHint: Target tokens before casting to apply Damage from the card.

incursion.name: Incursion
incursion.effect: A Level 4 Dimensional Gateway opens to an unknown dimension; an exonome of the spell's Level enters the Zone. More may follow unless it is sealed.

outbreak.name: Outbreak
outbreak.effect: All Zones within Medium Range become a Hazard inflicting Psychological Damage equal to the spell's Level.

summons.name: Summons
summons.effect: An exonome of the spell's Level is summoned into the Zone. Without a body it attempts Possession immediately; with one it lashes out and tries to escape.

groundZero.name: Ground Zero
groundZero.effect: The caster's Zone becomes a Hazard inflicting Psychological Damage equal to the spell's Level.

psychologicalInjury.name: Psychological Injury
psychologicalInjury.effect: The caster suffers a Psychological Injury: Level 1 Minor, Level 2–3 Serious, Level 4+ Deadly.

warping.name: Warping
warping.effect: The GM warps the Environmental Traits of the caster's Zone, scaled to the spell's Level.

miscast.name: Miscast
miscast.effect: A second spell fires at the same Level: Astral Projection (self), Destiny Entanglement Geas (creature) or Energy Transference (Zone/object).

darkFuture.name: Dark Future
darkFuture.effect: Visions of CASE NIGHTMARE GREEN: the caster gains a successful Prognostication at the spell's Level.

Complication.Title: Computational Complication
Complication.OncePerMission: Computational sorcery: once per mission you may roll on the Computational Complications table instead of the Mishap table.
Complication.SurgeNote: Everything in the Zone takes {damage} Damage.

surge.name: Surge
surge.effect: Eldritch lightning fries the device for good. All creatures in the Zone take 3 Damage and electrical devices are damaged; a saturated Zone becomes a Major Hazard.

fault.name: Fault
fault.effect: The device crashes. Repair: IT, or DN 4:3 Mind (Technology) with an hour spare.

reboot.name: Reboot
reboot.effect: Switch it off and on again (Free Action); unavailable until the end of your next Turn.

bugged.name: Bugged
bugged.effect: Spells cast with the device get +1 Complexity. Debug: IT, or DN 4:2 Mind (Technology) over 1 hour.

popUp.name: Pop-Up
popUp.effect: Spam floods the screen. Spend an Action clearing it before using the device again.

lowPower.name: Low Power
lowPower.effect: Battery drained (or fuse tripped). Unusable until recharged / reset.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.effect: Until cooled for a minute, every spell cast through the device triggers a complication.

hack.name: Hack
hack.effect: A low-Level extra-dimensional parasite possesses the device.

armWound.name: Arm Wound
armWound.effect: You drop an object. Body (Dexterity) DN +1 until healed.

legWound.name: Leg Wound
legWound.effect: You are knocked Prone. Body (Athletics) DN +1 until healed.

headWound.name: Head Wound
headWound.effect: Stunned until the end of your next turn. Body (Reflexes) DN +1 until healed.

internalInjury.name: Internal Injury
internalInjury.effect: Incapacitated until the end of your next turn. Body (Fortitude, Might) DN +1 until healed.

brokenArm.name: Broken Arm
brokenArm.effect: You drop an object. Melee and Accuracy −1 step; two-armed Tests DN +1 until healed.

brokenLeg.name: Broken Leg
brokenLeg.effect: Knocked Prone. Speed −1 step; Body (Athletics, Stealth) DN +1 until healed.

brainInjury.name: Brain Injury
brainInjury.effect: Unconscious until the end of your next turn. You always act last; all Body Tests DN +1 until healed.

instantDeath.name: Instant Death
instantDeath.effect: You instantly die a gruesome death!

shocked.name: Shocked
shocked.effect: You scream. Mind (Intuition) DN +1 until healed.

phobia.name: Phobia
phobia.effect: Frightened of the cause of this Injury until healed.

confused.name: Confused
confused.effect: Stunned until the end of your next turn. Mind (Awareness) DN +1 until healed.

existentialDread.name: Existential Dread
existentialDread.effect: Incapacitated until the end of your next turn. Spirit (Resolve) DN +1 until healed.

realityDenial.name: Reality Denial
realityDenial.effect: Blinded and Deafened until the end of your next turn. Spirit (Zeal) and Mind (Magic) DN +1 until healed.

traumatised.name: Traumatised
traumatised.effect: Terrified of the cause of this Injury until healed.

hallucinations.name: Hallucinations
hallucinations.effect: Unconscious until the end of your next turn. No Extended Tests; all Mind and Spirit Tests DN +1 until healed.

brokenMind.name: Broken Mind
brokenMind.effect: Your mind crumbles into an unwaking coma.

closeCall.name: Close Call
closeCall.effect: A minor feature (lights, radio, mirror) is damaged.

shriekingEngine.name: Shrieking Engine
shriekingEngine.effect: Everyone within Medium Range while it runs is Deafened.

bustedSteering.name: Busted Steering
bustedSteering.effect: Body (Reflexes) Tests to control the vehicle DN +1.

smoke.name: Smoke!
smoke.effect: Everyone aboard while it runs is Blinded.

fire.name: Fire!
fire.effect: Everyone aboard suffers a Minor Physical Injury; +1d6 on further Fault rolls.

catastrophe.name: Catastrophe
catastrophe.effect: Something vital comes apart. The vehicle is Wrecked.

Vehicle.Hint: Vehicles are immune to Psychological Damage; overflow Damage becomes Faults.
Vehicle.Overloaded: Overloaded: +1 Difficulty to the driver's Body (Reflexes) Tests.

Damage.Critical: Critically Injured! Death Test at the start of next turn.

Death.LastStandDeclared: {name} makes a Last Stand! Immune to damage until the end of the turn.
Death.LastStandEnds: {name}'s Last Stand is over. The team's Luck is refilled by the sacrifice.
Death.PromptText: Critically Injured at the start of the turn: make a Death Test, declare a Last Stand, or spend Luck.

Recovery.BreatherHint: 1 hour: recover half your maximum Toughness.
Recovery.RestHint: 6 hours: Toughness to maximum; a medic may treat one Injury.

LuckThreat.Title: Luck & Threat
LuckThreat.LuckTooltip: Team Luck: maximise, reroll, regain Adrenaline, recover Toughness, cheat death.
LuckThreat.ThreatTooltip: Threat 1–10: how close the world is to CASE NIGHTMARE GREEN.
LuckThreat.IncreaseMaxHint: A great deed: maximum Luck +1, Luck refilled, Threat −1.
LuckThreat.ConsentQuestion: Luck is a team resource. Did the team agree?
LuckThreat.SpentMaximise: Luck spent to maximise a Test. Luck {luck}.
LuckThreat.SpentReroll: Luck spent to reroll dice. Luck {luck}.
LuckThreat.SpentToughness: Luck spent to recover Toughness. Luck {luck}.
LuckThreat.SpentAdrenaline: Luck spent to regain Adrenaline. Luck {luck}.
LuckThreat.SpentCheatDeath: Luck spent to cheat death! Luck {luck}.
LuckThreat.SpentCarefulCasting: Careful Casting: Luck spent to reroll. Luck {luck}.
LuckThreat.SpentWithoutConsent: Luck spent without the team's consent! Luck {luck}, Threat {threat}.
LuckThreat.MaxIncreased: The team's bond strengthens: Luck {luck}, Threat {threat}.
LuckThreat.ThreatReset: The adventure ends. Threat resets to {threat}.
LuckThreat.LastStandRefill: A heroic sacrifice! Luck refilled to {luck}.
LuckThreat.KPILong: Long-term KPI achieved! Luck refilled to {luck}.
LuckThreat.RecoverToughnessHint: Action: spend 1 Luck to recover all Toughness.
LuckThreat.RegainAdrenalineHint: Spend 1 Luck to regain all Adrenaline.
LuckThreat.ThreatSpell: The forecasts darken — CASE NIGHTMARE GREEN draws closer. Threat {threat}.

Team.SkillMatrixHint: highest dice pool in the team (Attribute + Training), then Focus
Team.ObjectivePlaceholder: Recover the ledger from the vicarage…
Team.NewMissionHint: Reset once-per-mission resources for all operatives, clear objectives and clues, zero the spend and list requisitioned kit that must be returned?
Team.StashHint: drag items here from a character sheet or the sidebar; hand them out with the hand icon
Team.StashEmpty: The lock-up is empty. Drop items here.
Team.ContactNote: Who they are, what they owe you…
Team.NoContacts: No contacts yet — drop an NPC.
Team.EvidenceHint: drop journal entries or pages to pin them

Requisition.Label: Requisition DN
Requisition.Hint: Mind (Bureaucracy) for paperwork, Mind (Presence) to sweet-talk the boffins in person. If denied, you can't ask for it again this mission.
Requisition.Title: Requisition: {item}
Requisition.AlreadyDenied: Your request for {item} was denied this mission — circumstances must change before you ask again.
Requisition.Issued: Issued — return it at the end of the mission.
Requisition.Denied: Request denied. Not again this mission.
Requisition.ReturnTitle: Mission over — Internal Logistics wants its kit back
Requisition.ReturnHint: Return these items in working order, or file a report on what happened to them.

Sheet.AttackHint: Target an enemy token, then click the weapon to attack.
Sheet.DropTalents: Drag Talents here from the compendium.

XP.Hint: Attributes: 1→2 3 XP, 2→3 5 XP, 3→4 10 XP. Training/Focus: level N costs N XP. Talent: 4 XP.
XP.TalentHint: Drag a Talent onto the sheet to buy it

Creator.Title: Induction
Creator.Name: Name
Creator.SkillsHint: Your Core Skill starts at Training 1 / Focus 1. Spend the Assignment XP on the listed Skills: level N costs N XP.
Creator.OverBudget: You have spent more XP than allowed.
Creator.Done: {name} has been inducted into the Laundry.
Creator.MemoBody: Welcome to Capital Laundry Services. Before you receive your Assignment, please complete the following induction. Choose a standard Assignment package — a typical employee of that role — or build a custom operative from scratch. Use a pencil: you may go back and change anything until the file is stamped.
Creator.ModeAssignmentHint: Pick one of 27 roles. Starting Attributes, Core Skill, Core Talent, equipment and XP for listed Skills come with it. Fast and by the book.
Creator.ModeCustomHint: Body, Mind and Spirit start at 1 and you get 40 XP to spend on Attributes, Skills and Talents (4 XP each).
Creator.AssignmentLead: Your day job defines your starting Attributes, Skills and Talents. Filter by department and click a file to read it.
Creator.PickAssignment: Select an Assignment to read its file.
Creator.AttrLeadSwap: These are the typical Attributes for your Assignment. You may swap the values of two Attributes — click two cards.
Creator.AttrLeadCustom: Raise Body, Mind and Spirit with XP: 1→2 costs 3, 2→3 costs 5, 3→4 costs 10.

AttrHint.body: Melee, Defence, Toughness. Strength, reflexes, coordination.
AttrHint.mind: Accuracy, Initiative, Natural Awareness. Reasoning and perception.
AttrHint.spirit: Adrenaline and force of will. Leaders, faces, sorcerers.

Creator.OneSwap: Only one swap is allowed — undo it first.
Creator.SkillsHintCustom: Buy Training (extra dice) and Focus (+1 to dice after the roll) in any Skill: level N costs N XP.
Creator.SpellLimit: You already know as many spells as your Talents allow.
Creator.EquipmentLead: Standard issue for your Assignment. Anything else must be requisitioned (and justified in triplicate).
Creator.NoEquipment: Custom operatives start with a phone, a warrant card and a personal ward — ask your GM.
Creator.DetailsLead: Name, appearance and goals. Dice buttons roll on the book's tables; everything can be edited.
Creator.BackgroundLead: The Inductee Questionnaire. Answer, roll, or write UNKNOWN — HR will return to it later.
Creator.ConnectionsHint: How you know the operatives sitting either side of you…
Creator.XPLeft: Unspent XP will be kept for later advancement.
Creator.FewTalents: You have not chosen all your optional Talents.

Talent.SkillKeysHint: Skill keys, comma separated (any one satisfies)
Talent.SeverNote: {name} is severed: it takes 1 Damage (ignoring Armour) whenever it Moves for the rest of the combat.
Talent.PressingAttackNote: Pressing Attack: {name} rolled a 6 and may Shove the target as a Free Action (knocking it Prone on success).
Talent.ModderNote: Modder: the first Computational Complication this mission is ignored.
Talent.BackupPlanHint: Backup Plan: reroll this failed Test with Complexity +1 (once per rest)

Dream.d2: Nightmares of CASE NIGHTMARE GREEN — no benefit from the Rest, Threat +1.
Dream.d3: A clue about another operative's Long-term Goal.
Dream.d45: A clue about another operative's Short-term Goal.
Dream.d1011: A clue about your Short-term Goal or KPI.
Dream.d12: A clue about your Long-term Goal or KPI.

Item.EffectsHint: Active Effects apply to the owner. Useful keys: system.bonuses.initiative, toughness, injuries, adrenaline, armour, damage, pool, meleeStep, accuracyStep, defenceStep, naturalAwareness.

LuckMaxOverride.Name: Maximum Luck override
LuckMaxOverride.Hint: 0 = number of player-owned Operatives (by the book).

ShowHud.Name: Show Luck & Threat tracker
ShowHud.Hint: Floating tracker in the bottom-left corner.

AutoDeath.Name: Death Test prompts
AutoDeath.Hint: Post a Death Test prompt when a Critically Injured combatant's turn starts.

AutoZones.Name: Regions become Laundry Zones
AutoZones.Hint: Any Region drawn with the Regions tool automatically gets a Laundry Zone behaviour (range bands, Environmental Traits).

ZoneLabels.Name: Show Zone labels
ZoneLabels.Hint: Zone names, traits and the range from your selected token on the canvas.

Notify.NoGM: No GM is connected to process this action.
Notify.NoLuck: The team has no Luck left.
Notify.NoLuckOnLuckTest: You cannot spend Luck on a Luck Test.
Notify.NoCharacter: Select a token or assign a character first.
Notify.NoCastingTalent: You need Computational Sorcerer or Traditional Magician.
Notify.ComplicationUsed: Computational Complication already used this mission.
Notify.CriticalNoRecovery: Cannot recover Toughness while Critically Injured.
Notify.NoRequisition: This item has no requisition DN.
Notify.NotEnoughXP: Not enough XP ({cost} needed, {available} available). Shift-click to override.
Notify.RamNeeds: Select a driver token and target the victim.

hazard.label: Hazard
hazard.hint: Damage when a creature first enters the Zone in an encounter or starts its turn there (OH p.103).

ignoreArmour.label: Hazard ignores Armour
ignoreArmour.hint: E.g. extreme temperatures, unless the armour is built for it.

cover.label: Cover
cover.hint: Ranged attacks against creatures in the Zone: Defence +1 (Partial) or +2 (Total) steps.

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.hint: Poorly Lit / Dark: can Hide; Mind (Awareness) and ranged attacks into the Zone at Disadvantage. Dark: Advantage on Stealth.

obscured.label: Obscured
obscured.hint: Lightly: Awareness Difficulty +1. Heavily: creatures in the Zone are effectively Blinded.

difficult.label: Difficult Terrain
difficult.hint: Speed one step lower; Body (Reflexes) Difficulty +1.

barrier.label: Barrier
barrier.hint: Getting in or out needs an Action and a Test set by the GM; the turn then ends.

autoAdjacent.label: Auto-detect neighbours
autoAdjacent.hint: Zones that touch (within half a grid square) are adjacent.

links.label: Also adjacent to
links.hint: Link Zones that don't touch (stairs, a corridor, a hatch).

note.label: Features / notes
note.hint: Doors, vats of alien isopods, tables to flip…

Pursuit.Title: Pursuit
Pursuit.NamePlaceholder: What's going on? ("Legging it down Whitehall")
Pursuit.AddSelected: Add selected tokens (or drop actors here)
Pursuit.DropHint: Drop actors or add selected tokens.
Pursuit.SelectTokens: Select one or more tokens first.
Pursuit.CallHint: Everyone rolls DN 4:1 from the Pursuit tracker:
Pursuit.NotAllRolled: Not everyone has rolled — missing results count as 0 successes.
Pursuit.NoDriver: This vehicle has no driver — set one on the vehicle sheet.
Pursuit.NeedBothSides: You need at least one Quarry and one Pursuer still in the chase.
Pursuit.Sacrificed: {name} falls behind and is caught — the others keep running.
